Description: STM32G0B1KBU6: Cortex-M0+ 64 MHz, 128 KB flash, 144 KB RAM, FDCAN
Notes: Arrives blank: flash over J3 (SWD). Exposed pad = VSS

Description: MCP2562-E/SN: CAN FD transceiver, VDD 5 V, VIO 3.3 V
Notes: STBY tied low; no termination on the card

Description: AP2112K-3.3: LDO 3.3 V 600 mA, EN tied to VIN
Si4735-D60: AM / FM / SW / LW receiver with RDS, I2C, digital audio out (slave)
Notes: ESD-sensitive (some pins < 2 kV HBM). Reference clock from DCLK (no oscillator)

Description: 74LVC1G125: single 3-state buffer (RET driver, off at reset)

Notes: LCSC C2682775. 8 MHz, CL 12 pF, ESR <= 180 R. With C8 / C9 = 12p the load is about 10 pF (about +20 ppm: fine for CAN, more start-up margin)
AN383 asks for <= 1 pF on the antenna pin. Check the 0402 land pattern against TI's DPY drawing

Description: 56nH: wire-wound inductor, Q >= 15 at 100 MHz (FM antenna match, AN383 fig. 23)
Notes: Bench-tune for the car whip and its cable; leave off if reception is better without

Description: BLM18 120R: ferrite bead 120 R at 100 MHz, 0.8 A (tuner VA)
Tuner address: 3-pad solder jumper, 1-2 bridged by a copper trace as delivered (SEN low, I2C 0x11)
AM from whip: 2-pad solder jumper, open as delivered (AM from the loopstick only)
Notes: Bridge only with a car-whip AM network (not in AN383)

Description: DigiDash slot: right-angle 2 x 15 male header on the bottom edge
Notes: Same part as the other cards. Body on the bottom edge; pins stand past it into the main board's slot socket

Description: SMA jack, edge mount, for 1.6 mm board (antenna)
Notes: Top edge. Motorola-to-SMA: no straight adapter is sold; use a short pigtail, DIN 41585 female to SMA male (not RP-SMA), e.g. Eightwood TB0188 (10 cm RG174, eBay / Superbat). Check the SMA end has a centre pin

Description: Debug serial: GND, TX, RX (USART1, 3.3 V)

Notes: Top edge; ferrite loopstick 180-450 uH on a wire pair
Crystal load caps (see Y1). C0G only

Description: 10k: Resistor 10k 1% (slot ID pull-up; RET buffer off)
100k: Resistor 100k 1% (rail idle pull-downs; tuner reset; RCLK)
0: MCLK to RCLK link (fallback reference clock)
